identity.description: An attacker repeatedly attempts to authenticate to sudo with incorrect credentials for a user, then succeeds. Cortex should detect this pattern as a potential brute force attack on sudo privileges. This behavior is flagged by the ABIOC 'Possible brute force on sudo user'.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Sudo Brute Force Attempt
biocs.description: Multiple failed sudo authentication attempts followed by a successful one within a short time window
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'sudo'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'bash'
| filter action_file_path contains 'sudo'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.1'

abiocs.name: Possible brute force on sudo user
abiocs.description: Detects repeated failed sudo authentications followed by a successful one, indicating brute force behavior
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'sudo'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'bash'
| filter action_file_path contains 'sudo'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.1'
abiocs.causality_anchor: sudo process execution with repeated failed auth attempts

xql_queries.name: Sudo Brute Force Hunt Query
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'sudo'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'bash'
| filter action_file_path contains 'sudo'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.1'
| comp count() as cnt by action_remote_ip, actor_process_image_name
| comp count() as cnt by agent_hostname
